_about: DOC 233 RATIFICATION (2026-09-09). The wiring for the five doc 233 candidates whose own 'CEO: ratify / revise / retire' line reads 'CEO approved ...'. The prose itself lives in the sibling ratified-<id>.txt files (script-extracted from doc 233's markdown, byte-verified against the source lines — never retyped). This JSON is read by BOTH the SQL generator that wrote the live authority_hooks rows and tests/edge/run-dpia-framework/doc233-dpia-ratified-hooks.test.ts, so the two can never drift. Every atom is in DPIA's closed vocabulary (HOOK_PRODUCT_REGISTRY.dpia / DPIA_ATOM_PHRASES); every paraphrase satisfies verify.ts's clauseFormErrors — both are asserted mechanically by the test. Candidates skipped (ratify line blank): #1, #2, #4, #5, #10b, #11, #13, #14, #16, #17, #18, #19, #20. #8/#9/#10 are suppressed/excluded rows with no prose and no ratify line.
